services.value: The Amherst Water Pollution Control Facility (WPCF) treats raw sewage via preliminary treatment (influent screening, grit chambers, equalization tanks with primary settling), secondary treatment using a two-stage oxygen activated sludge process, and tertiary treatment including an intermediate pump station and sand filters for final polishing. Disinfection is done using sodium hypochlorite (with dechlorination) and treated effluent is discharged to Tonawanda Creek under a State Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (SPDES) permit.
